hypotheses.reconstruction_rule: Each member G(arg) is recovered by applying the corresponding argument substitution operator to the latent object G(z).
required_assumptions: G is an uninterpreted function symbol
a, b, c are declared symbols
the catalog members are not simplified or rewritten beyond the listed substitutions
